一: its whole body is one long horizontal bar, like a friendly caterpillar lying flat, eyes at the left end
二: two stacked horizontal bars form its body, the shorter one on top like a hat brim, the longer one below as its belly
三: three stacked horizontal bars: a short top bar as eyebrows, a middle bar as the face, a long bottom bar as the body
十: a plus-shaped body: a tall vertical trunk crossed by a horizontal bar that forms two outstretched arms
人: two long legs spread wide like the two strokes of 人, a tiny head on top, no arms, standing proudly
大: a figure with arms stretched straight out to both sides and legs spread, like the character 大
小: a tiny body with one vertical hooked tail in the middle and two small dots as eyes on either side
口: a square boxy face where the mouth is a huge wide-open rectangle filling most of the face
日: a round warm sun body with a single horizontal line across the middle that is its closed smiling eyes
月: a crescent-moon shaped body seen from the side, with two short horizontal lines inside as stripes
山: three stone peaks rise from its head like a crown, the middle peak tallest, a wide flat rocky base for feet
水: a water-drop body with a central vertical hook and two splashes curling out on each side
火: a tall central flame on top with two small sparks leaning outward left and right like the two dots of 火
木: a small tree: a sapling sprouting from its head, two arms held straight out like the horizontal stroke, legs spread like the two lower strokes
上: a short vertical stem standing on a long flat base, with a small branch pointing right, like an arrow pointing up
下: a long flat top like a roof with a vertical stem hanging down and a small dot, like an arrow pointing down
中: a square box body pierced by one tall vertical pole through the middle, like a flag on a pole
手: a hand-shaped creature: a wide palm with fingers fanning out at the top and one long curved tail
目: a tall vertical eye-shaped body with two horizontal lines inside, like a big eye with lids
田: a square body divided into four equal windows, like a rice field seen from above
土: a short wide figure: a vertical stem standing on a long flat base with a shorter bar across its middle
牛: a bull: two horns on top, a long vertical face, horizontal stripes across the snout
鸟: a bird: one dot as the eye, a hooked beak, a curved wing swept back, standing on a long tail
天: a wide flat hat (the top bar) over a figure with outstretched arms and spread legs, looking up at the sky
